item.title: Berlin-based Pliant raised an $80M Series C led by Seaya Nova and Speedinvest, as it opens its B2B payments infrastructure to AI agents (Cristian Dina/The Next Web)
item.description:
Cristian Dina / The Next Web:
Berlin-based Pliant raised an $80M Series C led by Seaya Nova and Speedinvest, as it opens its B2B payments infrastructure to AI agents  —  Claude, ChatGPT and in-house AI agents can now run business payments through Pliant.  The Berlin fintech, past $100M in recurring revenue, will expand in North America.

Original (direct link): https://thenextweb.com/news/pliant-80m-series-c-ai-agents-b2b-payments-seaya-speedinvest

item.title: OpenAI details a pipeline that used an upcoming cyber model to validate and patch 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Linux for $1.2M in API costs (OpenAI)
item.description:
OpenAI:
OpenAI details a pipeline that used an upcoming cyber model to validate and patch 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Linux for $1.2M in API costs  —  Security research that once required a separate, sustained investigation for each finding can increasingly be run as a systematic process.

Original (direct link): https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root
